justification: Inspected `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/stmt/AssertStmt.java` and `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/metamodel/AssertStmtMetaModel.java`. `AssertStmt` is a small generated AST node with only two state fields (`check` and optional `message`) and a narrow set of responsibilities: constructors, getters/setters, `remove`, `replace`, `clone`, and type-casting/visitor methods; there is no evidence of many independent concerns or a large, fragmented method set. The meta model also defines only two properties (`check`, `message`), reinforcing the class’s limited scope rather than insufficient modularization.
